title: ThermoPheno
text: ThermoPheno R package Shiny application thermal-time-based crop phenology simulation. estimates crop planting, maturity, harvest timing daily minimum maximum temperature data supports historical analysis, climate-scenario comparison, observed-phenology validation, benchmarking external crop calendar agro-hydrological model outputs. Package website: https://mr-eini.github.io/ThermoPheno/ Repository: https://github.com/MR-Eini/ThermoPheno

title: ThermoPheno
text: Thermal-time simulation using simple, capped, triangular temperature-response formulations. Summer winter crop workflows, including simplified winter dormancy vernalization logic. Baseline thermal-time calibration reference planting date days--maturity period. Dynamic planting-date detection based temperature conditions within user-defined planting window. Climate-scenario comparison multi-model, multi-scenario, multi-period, multi-station files. Observed-phenology validation support comparing simulated crop calendar dates independent phenological observations. Interactive Shiny interface uploading weather data, configuring crop parameters, running simulations, visualising results.

title: ThermoPheno
text: Crop development driven air temperature . Daily mean temperature calculated (tmin + tmax) / 2. winter-crop workflow uses simplified vernalization dormancy rules. Photoperiod, radiation, water stress, cultivar differences, management adaptation, frost-kill processes explicitly modelled. growing season simulated independently.

text: Initial formal R-package structure. Added thermal-time functions: simple, capped, triangular methods. Added summer- winter-crop simulation logic. Added Shiny application launcher. Added observed-calendar thermal-time calibration estimate_required_tt_from_observed(). Added testthat unit tests example weather/scenario data.
